### Security (P0 trio)

**S1 — Server hardening.** Flask now binds `127.0.0.1` by default (was `0.0.0.0`, exposing the trading API to the whole LAN). SocketIO CORS is locked to `http://localhost:5000`, `http://127.0.0.1:5000`, `http://localhost:1420`, `http://127.0.0.1:1420`, and `tauri://localhost` (was `*`). New `before_request` API auth gate refuses any `/api/*` request without a valid JWT, with an explicit allow-list for the auth flows themselves, the launcher health-check, onboarding bootstrap, public share-key previews, and Stripe webhooks. Override the bind host via `TRADESPACE_BIND_HOST` for headless dev.

**S2 — At-rest encryption for sensitive credential columns.** `user_configs.value` previously stored broker password, Telegram api_hash, Discord bot token, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq keys, Stripe secret, and webhook secret in plaintext. New `crypto.py` module wraps `cryptography.fernet` with a 32-byte master key persisted to `%APPDATA%/TradeSpace/.master.key` (user-only ACL, mirrors the `.flask_secret` pattern). `database.set_user_config` encrypts on write for keys in `crypto.SENSITIVE_KEYS`; `get_user_config` decrypts on read and lazy-rewrites legacy plaintext rows on first touch. Non-sensitive keys take the unchanged plaintext path. Note: master-key (not password-derived) — a password-derived key would break the always-on engine when the user logs out of the dashboard.

**S3 — XSS fixes in dashboard.html.** Audited 102 `innerHTML` sites for user-data injection and patched the six high-risk paths: session notes (`n.text`, `n.time`), activity feed (`a.text`, `a.type`, `a.time`), log entries (`e.msg`, `e.level`, `e.color`, `e.ts`), and the avatar render path (data-URI XSS via `localStorage.pfp` and `FileReader.result`). New `_safeImg(parent, src, fallbackText)` helper validates avatar src as a base64 image data URI (png/jpg/gif/webp) before injection — anything else routes to a textContent fallback. Existing `_esc()` helper now wraps every user-data flow in the patched paths.

### Migrations
- `14_add_value_enc_to_user_configs` — non-destructive `ALTER TABLE user_configs ADD COLUMN value_enc TEXT`. Existing plaintext rows in `value` migrate to `value_enc` (Fernet ciphertext) on first read of any sensitive key.

### Tests
- 141/141 tests pass (test_database, test_live_pnl, test_metrics, test_history_range, test_core_bugs).
- New crypto smoke tests cover roundtrip + sensitive/non-sensitive routing + lazy-migration of legacy plaintext.
